QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Eyeful's Treasure
QuestInfo.0: You found an Eyeful flying around on a strange leaf among the trees.
QuestInfo.1: The Eyeful led you to a small treasure trove stuffed full of shiny things of all sorts, including Cayne's lost brooch. Now that you and Alika have recovered all of the lost items, you can reunite them with their owners.
